start.title: The King's Harp
start.text:
Saul's eyes are dark and tired.
The harp waits in your hands.

choices.feedback: A servant does not scorn the king.
1 Samuel 16:23 — David played the harp to soothe Saul when an evil spirit was upon him.
Pride poisons your gift.

mock_consequence.title: Honor the King
mock_consequence.text:
Even a jealous king is the Lord's anointed.
Serve with humility.

choices.feedback: You bow your head and play.

demand_consequence.title: Lay Down Your Pride
demand_consequence.text:
Greatness comes through service.
Return to your task.

choices.feedback: Your fingers find the strings.

jealousy.title: The Women Sing
jealousy.text:
"Saul slew thousands, David tens of thousands."
Saul's face turns to stone.

choices.feedback: Words like these light a fire.
1 Samuel 18:8-9 — Saul was very angry and jealous when the women sang about David's victories.
Do not strike at the crown.

boast_consequence.title: Quiet Your Tongue
boast_consequence.text:
Glory belongs to God alone.
Let humility answer.

choices.feedback: You hold your peace.

shame_consequence.title: Honor Above Anger
shame_consequence.text:
Saul is still the Lord's anointed.
Speak nothing against him.

choices.feedback: You bow and step aside.

spear.title: Spear in the Air
spear.text:
Saul's spear flies past your head.
It buries deep in the wall.

choices.text: Draw your sword on the king
choices.feedback: Never lift a hand against him.
Anger is not your weapon.
1 Samuel 18:10-11 — Saul hurled a spear at David, but David eluded him twice.

sword_consequence.title: Stay Your Hand
sword_consequence.text:
The Lord chose Saul.
Do not take what God will give.

choices.feedback: You sheathe your blade.

curse_consequence.title: Hold Your Tongue
curse_consequence.text:
Cursing him will not free you.
Leave with quiet dignity.

choices.feedback: You step into the corridor.

jonathan_warns.title: A Friend in the Field
jonathan_warns.text:
Jonathan grips your arm.
"My father seeks your life. Run."

choices.feedback: 1 Samuel 19:1-2 — Jonathan warned David that Saul his father was seeking to kill him, and told him to hide.
Do not walk into the spear.
He risks all to save you.

confront_consequence.title: Do Not Return
confront_consequence.text:
Saul's heart is closed for now.
The Lord has another path.

choices.feedback: You take his counsel to heart.

doubt_consequence.title: Trust His Love
doubt_consequence.text:
Jonathan's covenant is your shield.
Receive his warning.

choices.feedback: You clasp his hand and go.

flee.title: Into the Wilderness
flee.text:
Saul's army hunts the red canyons.
Your men whisper of vengeance.

choices.text: Raise a war band against Saul
choices.feedback: Do not fight the Lord's anointed.

choices.text: Hide in the hills and pray
choices.feedback: 1 Samuel 23:14 — David stayed in the wilderness in strongholds, and Saul sought him every day, but God did not give David into his hand.
Trust God, not strangers.

war_consequence.title: Lay Down the Sword
war_consequence.text:
Civil blood would stain your name.
Seek the Lord instead.

choices.text: Hide in the hills and pray
choices.feedback: You climb the rocky path.

foreign_consequence.title: Stay Near the Lord
foreign_consequence.text:
Foreign kings cannot keep you.
God alone is your refuge.

choices.text: Hide in the hills and pray
choices.feedback: You turn back toward the wilderness.

cave.title: Saul Sleeps Within Reach
cave.text:
Saul lies asleep in your cave.
Your men whisper, "God has given him."

choices.feedback: Never harm the Lord's anointed.
Show mercy without malice.

choices.text: Cut only the corner of his robe
choices.feedback: 1 Samuel 24:4 — David secretly cut off a corner of Saul's robe while Saul was in the cave.

strike_consequence.title: Stay Your Blade
strike_consequence.text:
Vengeance belongs to God.
Let mercy be your witness.

choices.text: Cut only the corner of his robe
choices.feedback: Your knife trembles, then turns.

wake_consequence.title: Speak with Honor
wake_consequence.text:
Anger will twist a true witness.
Let your deed speak first.

choices.text: Cut only the corner of his robe
choices.feedback: You crouch silently beside him.

mercy_call.title: I Could Have Killed You
mercy_call.text:
From the cliff you raise the cloak.
Saul weeps. "You are more righteous than I."
